title: Group
description: More than one person shares the frame. Each person stays sharp, and a chair someone is clearly sitting on can stay too. Each face is lifted slightly and the place behind them falls softer without disappearing.
reason: Several people share the frame, so each face is lifted slightly and the background stays softer without disappearing.

features.person: Each person stays sharp, with the face lifted a little.
features.seat: A chair someone is clearly sitting on stays sharp with them.
features.background: The place behind the group falls softer without disappearing.

subject.skip: Skip the faces when fewer than two people are clearly present.

eyes.skip: Skip the eyes when no eye is found on the group.

skin.skip: Skip skin when the faces have no skin tones to smooth.

sky.skip: Skip the sky. The sky is not a separate grade here.

background.skip: Skip the background when the faces could not be isolated.

foreground.skip: Skip the foreground. The frame is handled by the global grade.
